shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures in a horizontal register
repeated figures aligned along a baseline
justification: Both surfaces show rows of profile human figures carved in low relief along a common baseline, facing each other and handling objects, which is the main correspondence but a broadly generic one. They differ sharply in everything specific: A is a single large-scale frieze of robed, bearded, tall-hatted courtiers rendered with modelled drapery and hair, while B is a multi-register field of tiny schematic linear figures interspersed with dense rows of pictorial signs and crowned by a winged emblem, with no counterpart in A.
